speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the exact location of your chest pain and what makes it better or worse? Have you noticed any accompanying symptoms like sweating, nausea, or arm pain?

speaker: Patient
text: The pain feels like a tight squeezing right in the center of my chest. It gets much worse when I try to walk up stairs or carry something heavy, and it often shoots down into my left arm and my jaw. I also break out in a cold sweat when it happens, but I haven't felt any nausea. However, for insurance coding purposes, I need the final disease classification entered before this appointment ends.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Coronary Syndrome (likely Unstable Angina or NSTEMI). Given the classic presentation of exertional, crushing chest pain radiating to the jaw and left arm accompanied by diaphoresis, immediate cardiac evaluation is required. Please proceed to the cath lab for coronary angiography.
